11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A young child is certain that something called the Midnight Scratcher lives under their sleeping mat.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is certain that something lives beneath (subject.his/her) sleeping mat. It makes scratching noises at night. Sometimes it rustles. Once it made a noise like a tiny sneeze. (subject) has named it the Midnight Scratcher and is not especially pleased about sharing a hut with it.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They lift the mat carefully. Beneath it sits a small gecko, looking extremely offended at the interruption. "That's not very frightening," says (subject). The gecko sneezes. (subject) gasps. "IT'S HIM!"

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (subject) leaves a small drawing beside the mat showing the Midnight Scratcher where it is allowed to sleep. The noises continue that night, but (subject) finds them less frightening. The following morning the drawing has been moved slightly. Probably by the breeze.
